reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP, and a brand with zero reviews at $29.99 is a lot to risk when I already have Subscribe & Save on magnesium that costs less per serving.
objection: No NSF or USP seal and no reviews, so "lab-tested" is just the brand's own word, and $1 a day is more than I pay now. I already count capsules into my pill case, so the sachets are nice but not worth extra money to me.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, or a few hundred real reviews, plus a price closer to $20 for the 30 days.
